title: Radar run beacon (sent by the pre-market Radar routine when one of its stages starts and when it ends)
description: One stage of one session's Radar run: which stage, where it stands, what started it and when. Times, ids, closed codes, booleans and integers only: no free text anywhere and nothing of an edition's content. Display only: it changes no edition, no pick and no alert. The site keeps the newest beacon per session and stage.

run_id.description: The id of the run this beacon belongs to: one token, no spaces. A beacon with the stored one's run_id and state is a resend.

as_of.description: When this beacon was written. Beacons of one session and stage are ordered by it.

session.description: The New York session date the run is for.

ended_at.description: When the stage ended; null while it runs.

exit_code.description: The stage's exit code; null while it runs or when it has none.

reason.description: Why the stage ended as it did, as a closed code.

checks.description: What the routine found ready before the stage.
